calculation_handling.description: A seniors community house must be at least 250 m from a lot with a seniors community house, measured lot line to lot line.
calculation_handling.gaps: Locations of other seniors community houses are not held; separation_m is a same-lot building distance.

units.disclosure: The 250 m minimum distance between seniors community houses is not evaluated; the locations of other such houses are not held.

150.30.30.1(1).explanation: A seniors community house must be at least 250 m, lot line to lot line, from a lot with another seniors community house.
